chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ: four, indicating a large counted number here
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship
key_terms.حَدٍّ: a limit, boundary, rule, or defined condition

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام mean by saying that prayer has four thousand limits?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that salat (prayer) is governed by numerous limits, conditions, and regulations. The hadith emphasizes the vast scope and precision of the rulings, etiquettes, and boundaries connected to prayer in Islam.
